page_title: Rajendra Prasad N - AWS Databricks Data Platform Engineer
headline: AWS Cloud Engineer | Databricks, Data Platforms, and Infrastructure Automation
summary_html: AWS Cloud Engineer with 10+ years of experience building cloud infrastructure, automating platform delivery, and supporting cloud-based data platforms across multi-account AWS environments. Strong hands-on background in Databricks on AWS, Terraform, CloudFormation, EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Python, and PowerShell, with recent experience provisioning Databricks environments, standardizing private networking and access controls, and supporting Databricks-based analytics and ETL/ELT platform workflows. Technically strong in infrastructure as code, CI/CD automation, cloud governance, observability, reliability, and cross-functional delivery for scalable AWS data platforms.

achievements.text: Designed and standardized AWS infrastructure for cloud-based application and data platforms using Terraform, CloudFormation, IAM, VPC, and reusable automation patterns.
Automated Databricks environment provisioning on AWS across isolated accounts, aligning network integration, IAM controls, and environment consistency for analytics and ETL platform workloads.
Built CI/CD workflows with AWS CodePipeline, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and GitLab CI to automate platform delivery, infrastructure updates, and release governance.
Implemented CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, and ELK-based monitoring patterns to improve platform visibility, performance, reliability, and cost-aware operations.
Integrated IAM, MFA, policy-driven controls, private networking, secrets handling, and Terraform validation into cloud delivery workflows to strengthen security and compliance.
